+def test_build_install_preserves_internal_links_and_copies_external_file(collection_input, tmp_path):
+    input_dir, output_dir = collection_input
+    os.makedirs(os.path.join(input_dir, 'inner'))
+    with open(os.path.join(input_dir, 'inner', 'data'), 'wb') as f:
+        f.write(b'internal data')
+    os.symlink('inner', os.path.join(input_dir, 'linked_dir'))
+    os.symlink('inner/data', os.path.join(input_dir, 'linked_file'))
+    outside = tmp_path / 'outside'
+    outside.write_bytes(b'external data')
+    os.symlink(to_text(outside), os.path.join(input_dir, 'copied_file'))
+
+    collection.build_collection(input_dir, output_dir, False)
+    artifact = os.path.join(output_dir, 'ansible_namespace-collection-0.1.0.tar.gz')
+    with tarfile.open(artifact) as tar:
+        assert tar.getmember('linked_dir').issym()
+        assert tar.getmember('linked_file').issym()
+        assert tar.getmember('copied_file').isfile()
+
+    destination = tmp_path / 'installed' / 'ansible_namespace' / 'collection'
+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    req = collection.CollectionRequirement.from_tar(to_bytes(artifact), False)
+    req.install_artifact(to_bytes(destination), to_bytes(tmp_path))
+    assert os.readlink(to_text(destination / 'linked_dir')) == 'inner'
+    assert os.readlink(to_text(destination / 'linked_file')) == 'inner/data'
+    assert (destination / 'linked_dir' / 'data').read_bytes() == b'internal data'
+    assert not (destination / 'copied_file').is_symlink()
+    assert (destination / 'copied_file').read_bytes() == b'external data'
+
